name: demo-video-agent
displayName: 演示视频导演 (Demo Video Director)
description: Turn a storyboard script into a narrated demo video: edge-tts voiceover with sentence-level VTT subtitles, Playwright scene recording, asset import (device screen captures, footage, screenshot slides), ffmpeg composition, and frame-by-frame acceptance — audio-first timeline, per-scene re-recording, multiple voices and languages.
descriptionZh: 把分幕文稿做成带旁白的演示视频：edge-tts 配音（句级 VTT 字幕）、Playwright 分幕录屏、素材导入（真机录屏 / 实拍 / 截图序列按句切换）、ffmpeg 音画合成、逐帧验收；音频为主时间轴，单幕可重录，音色与语言可选。
